findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: web_search, web_scrape, polymarket_quote · Private data: token_price, wallet_profile, token_risk_score, whale_alert, dex_liquidity, token_holders, wallet_pnl, copy_trade_signals, swap_quote, wallet_balance, dex_search, pair_data, trending_tokens, new_pairs, token_security, token_metadata, holder_changes, top_traders, volume_alert, dependency_risk_score, crypto_sentiment, smart_money, bridge_route_optimizer, secrets_detection, lst_yields, polymarket_quote, hedge_plan, spawn_agent · Public sink: hedge_plan, options_volatility, open_interest_change · Destructive: transaction_parse.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: web_search, web_scrape, polymarket_quote · Private data: token_price, wallet_profile, token_risk_score, whale_alert, dex_liquidity, token_holders, wallet_pnl, copy_trade_signals, swap_quote, wallet_balance, dex_search, pair_data, trending_tokens, new_pairs, token_security, token_metadata, holder_changes, top_traders, volume_alert, dependency_risk_score, crypto_sentiment, smart_money, bridge_route_optimizer, secrets_detection, lst_yields, polymarket_quote, hedge_plan, spawn_agent · Public sink: hedge_plan, options_volatility, open_interest_change · Destructive: transaction_parse

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
